people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.
translations.bsb: When Joseph came home, they presented him with the gifts they had brought, and they bowed to the ground before him.
translations.kjv: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
translations.asv: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed down themselves to him to the earth.
